noveltyJustification: Both findings are new to this lineage: the scoring asymmetry is proven by executing the shipped router, and the leaf-scopes description mismatch is a first read of that file. Neither restates a closed 014 item.

title: The three canonical mode ids do not route to all three modes
leaf-scopes.json is described as per-mode but holds one mode

detail: P1: a prompt naming the three published workflowMode ids routes to two modes because chrome and aside vocabularies double-count their own id while bladebro does not; proven by executing compiled-route.cjs.
P2: README.md:58 describes leaf-scopes.json as per-mode while the file holds one mode entry; SKILL.md:106 states the narrower truth.

reason: hub-router.json:130-141 documents the exclusion and offers verb forms; intended behaviour, not a bug.

direction: ambiguityDelta too tight to ever bundle
reason: executing the router on bladebro chrome devtools aside devtools returns all three as orderedBundle.
